items.title: Conservative: Aave USDC lending
items.summary: Keeps capital in stablecoins and lends it on Aave. Each transaction is capped at 100 USD and each day at 300 USD.

items.title: Diversified: lending, vaults, Morpho and swaps (testnet)
items.summary: Lends on Aave, deposits in Stata vaults, supplies to Morpho Blue, and swaps on Uniswap v3. Each transaction is capped at 100 USD and each day at 300 USD.
